verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own docs list routing forms as a core feature. The API exposes a routing trace that shows how a booking passed through routing forms, CRM lookups and host selection logic, which confirms first-party form-driven routing to hosts. Team round-robin settings with priority, weights, host groups and CRM fallback support assignment to the right person or team. Missing for 10: documentation of how routing-form questions and answer-based rules are configured to qualify invitees, explicit evidence of routing to different teams or redirecting unqualified leads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
